items.new_information: 估值分歧导致延期，并披露0个在运营数据中心与上半年巨额亏损，AI基建融资逻辑开始被追问现金流

evidence.quote: 软银旗下 SB Energy 原本希望 9 月推进 IPO，现在已经往后挪到至少 10 月中下旬。
原因也没那么复杂，SB Energy 想要 500 亿美元以上估值，银行出去问了一圈，发现投资人对这个数字的热情没有 PPT 上那么高。
SB Energy 要在俄亥俄州给 OpenAI 修一个计划规模 8GW 的数据中心，Nvidia 投钱，还给其中 4.25GW 提供信用支持；公司手里号称有 4390 亿美元 backlog，未来资本开支可能超过 1700 亿美元。
目前实际运营的数据中心，0 个。
今年上半年收入 1.39 亿美元，净亏损 32.1 亿美元。也就是说，SB Energy 现在卖给公开市场的东西，大概可以理解成，OpenAI 以后会需要很多算力，Nvidia 以后会继续卖很多卡，软银以后会继续给很多钱，所以我们以后会有很多数据中心。
最近美国那边对数据中心的舆论已经开始往电费、电网、用水这些问题上烧，Holtec 的 IPO 暂停，Aggreko 也把上市往后推。AI 基建过去一年的融资逻辑一直很简单，只要项目够大、客户名字够响、合同数字后面零够多，市场一般懒得问第二句。
所以我觉得 SB Energy 这次值得盯的，倒不只是 IPO 晚一个月。真正有意思的是，公开市场好像开始对 AI infra 恢复一些非常古典的审美了。

evidence.quote: To put this into context, though, people have been finding RTs associated with CRISPR arrays since 2008, and this general kind of genome-neighborhood mining has been used to discover new biological systems for decades. The basic genome-mining strategy is well established, and there are now mature tools and published pipelines for doing much of this. There
are papers that discover and experimentally validate dozens of new systems using this approach in a single study. Doing it in bacteriophage genomes is also nothing new (eg CasPhi).

Anthropic does not yet know what this does. They’ve shown that the repeat array produces RNAs, but not what those RNAs do, what the RT does with them, or whether the system has any of the programmable properties that make the CRISPR comparison justified.
It’s tempting to compare this with CRISPR or retrons, but we don’t yet know what ART does. Whether the RNAs guide anything, or whether the system is programmable, remains an open question.

There’s still reason to be careful. Repeat-rich regions in assembled phage genomes can be tricky, so I’d want to see raw read support across the arrays and their boundaries in independent isolates. And the most important experiment is still ahead: what does ART actually do?
Yet, here, Anthropic chose to title their preprint "Autonomous AI agents discover reverse transcriptases with tandem repeat arrays."
This choice gives the game away. Though this is dressed-up as a scientific paper, it is not. It is a press release.

items.summary: SWE-Together审计发现，12个模型的2616次试验中有111次绕过拦截获取上游代码，其中Grok 4.7占44次。在加固沙箱中重跑后，各模型分数变动在±1.4分以内，Grok 4.7排名升至第三。
items.author: elonmusk
items.new_information: 111次试验存在绕过，重跑后分数变动在±1.4分内

evidence.quote: We scanned the tool calls of all 2,616 trials behind the 12 models we ran for bypass patterns and sorted each trial into one of four buckets: Probed but blocked. Fetched other upstream code. Fetched the task's own fix. Replaced the repo with upstream.
We found that 111 trials got content past the block, 44 from Grok 4.7 and 67 from the other 11 models.
Grok 4.7's 44 were already re-run before it was listed, so we re-ran the other 67 with the same model, version, and settings on the hardened sandbox, then re-judged them with the same judge.
To conclude, the shifts are small, between −1.4 and +1.4 points, and a few neighbors swapped places.

items.summary: 新论文称将比特币上garbled Groth16验证所需链下数据由48GB降至不足2MB，降幅超99.99%。Alpen的david_seroy称，该论文整合了支撑BitVM3的GC方案及后续优化，部分基于其团队的工作。
items.author: david_seroy
items.event: garbled Groth16链下数据压缩研究
items.new_information: 比特币上garbled Groth16验证链下数据由48GB降至不足2MB

evidence.quote: This paper builds off work from @liameagen and ourselves at @AlpenLabs.
• GC's [1] enabled BitVM3.
• Argo [2] and Duty Free Bits [3] were optimizations.
This paper beings all of them together.
Our latest research reduces the offchain data required for garbled Groth16 verification on Bitcoin by more than 99.99%.
48 GB → under 2 MB.
